# Maintenance Request

## Description
A clear and concise description of what maintenance needs to be done.

## Task Details
Provide details about the maintenance task:
- What files or areas of the codebase are affected?
- What specific maintenance is needed?
- Are there any dependencies or related tasks?

## Priority
- [ ] Low - Can be done anytime
- [ ] Medium - Should be done soon
- [ ] High - Needs to be done this sprint
- [ ] Critical - Blocking other work

## Estimated Effort
- [ ] Small (1-2 hours)
- [ ] Medium (1-2 days)
- [ ] Large (3-5 days)

## Additional Context
Any other context about the maintenance task here.
